intro:
Bubble Fish is a captivating browser-based puzzle game developed by GamePix that has been making waves in the online gaming community. 
             The game's core premise revolves around matching and connecting fish and starfish of the same color and type, either horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
             With its intuitive controls and addictive gameplay mechanics, Bubble Fish stands out as a must-play experience for fans of puzzle games.
             Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a casual online experience, Bubble Fish is sure to provide hours of entertainment and challenge your skills.


             The game features simple yet effective controls that can be used with either a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, making it accessible to players of all ages and backgrounds.
             The objective of the game is to clear levels by creating connections of three or more fish or starfish of the same color and type.
             With each level cleared, players earn points and stars, which can be used to unlock special items and improve their score in the shop.
             To progress through the game and unlock new levels, players need to clear at least two stars or more in each level.


             Bubble Fish is a game that is both easy to learn and challenging to master. The game's simple yet addictive gameplay mechanics make it a great option for players looking for a casual online experience.
             However, as players progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly difficult, requiring careful planning and strategy to clear each level.
